quick_tests.command: uv run --frozen --extra dev pytest -q tests/test_investigation_rehearsal.py tests/test_swarm_pipeline.py tests/test_swarm.py tests/test_expanding_search.py tests/test_investigation_stop_reasons.py
quick_tests.environment: Fresh worktree development environment, not the clean wheel environments

limits: The rehearsal uses scripted agents, outputs, timing, and memory.
Two synthetic specialists are covered by the script; the separate quick tests cover the three-investigator swarm.
The bounded synthetic stop is not a change to the normal uncapped plateau rule.
These results establish controller behavior, not real inference quality, performance, or search superiority.
